messages:
sophie: Heads-up — deploybot blocked release 'stable/0.9.5' during final gate.

deploy-bot: [automated] Release pipeline halted. Reason: vulnerable transitive dependency detected in third_party/crypto-lib@1.2.3 (CVE-2026-8421). SBOM provenance mismatch: source signature missing. Action: BLOCK. Link: https://infra/reports/1728901234

alan: Ugh. Is this transitive from our internal vendor fork or pulled directly from upstream?

izzy-security: CVE looks medium-high (CVSS 7.2). We need repro steps + exploitability. Sophie, can you paste sbom diff?

sophie: Quick grep output:
```
- crypto-lib 1.2.2 -> verified sig: ok
- crypto-lib 1.2.3 -> provenance: unknown, signed_by: none
```

jess: Do we have a backpatch on 1.2.2 or a patched 1.2.3 build from vendor? If not, pin to 1.2.2 and re-run tests.

maya-release: We have a change window in 3 hours. If we can't fix before then we either delay GA or ship with an exception + mitigation. Don't want a rollback mid-rollout.

izzy-security: Exception requires documented compensating controls: runtime WAF rule, canary fraction 5%, and commit to patch timeline within 48h.

alan: Can we do a temporary patch by vendoring the safe subset and rebuild image? Might be 1-2 hours work.

sophie: I can assemble a minimal repro and open a JIRA. If we choose pin -> will need coordinator sign-off from legal? vendor license ok?

jess: Legal usually only for license changes, this is dependency pin within semver constraints. Maya, will you approve patch or pin for the change window?

maya-release: Approve pin-to-1.2.2 for canary only. Full rollout paused until security gives patch + provenance verified. Update release notes: "Canary limited due to third-party vuln; mitigation in progress." I'll tag the SHA and hold the deploy.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary deploy initiated to 5% with pinned crypto-lib@1.2.2. Monitor: /dash/releases/stable/0.9.5/canary

izzy-security: I'll run dynamic checks and confirm exploitability. If all good, we'll lift hold. Otherwise escalate to oncall for emergency hotpatch.

alan: Opening JIRA: INF-4321 "Pin crypto-lib -> 1.2.2 for canary; vendor provenance missing for 1.2.3". Assigning to @sophie.

sophie: Got it. I'll also add a short snippet in release notes and notify the customer success SLA channel.

jess: Add a post-deploy smoke test for crypto ops (encrypt/decrypt roundtrip) to the canary gate.

maya-release: Thanks team. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
